A Descriptive Catalogue of the Sanskrit Manuscripts in the Tanjore Maharaja Serfoji’s Sarasvati Mahal Library, Tanjore (Tanjore). Vols. 1–19.
Composed at the occasion of the sacrifice which Tryambakarāyamakhin performed in Svāmimalai near Kumbhakonam. It received the approbation of Rāmabhadra Dīkṣita.
